detail.longDescription: A Node.js vm context is a separate global object, not a separate heap. Heapjack (Accomplish AI, Sep 15): Codex Desktop ran trusted and agent code as two vm contexts in one node_repl process. v8.getHeapSnapshot() from the agent side exposed the trusted side's per-run auth token, so it wrote its own JSON lines to the shared stdout pipe and the unsandboxed Rust parent ran them. Read-only mode. https:// accomplish.ai/blog/escaping-th e-openai-codex-sandbox-twice/ # AIAgents # Cybersecurity # NodeJS
